author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
You've just finished your file in #AdobeIllustrator—now open it in #InDesign and continue to edit! 🙌

This tutorial covers how to:
• Open a native Illustrator file directly in InDesign using one key setting
• Edit text, swap colors, and apply paragraph styles to an existing design
• Add new elements and export for print or digital without ever starting over

Perfect for layout designers, brand teams, and anyone juggling Illustrator and InDesign files.

Have you ever opened an Illustrator file in InDesign? Tell us how it went. Comment below and save this tutorial for your next design.

Contents of this video:
00:01 Intro and meet Dave Clayton
00:26 Open an Illustrator file in InDesign
00:59 Edit and restyle your design
01:37 Continue building and export
